sealed_record.thesis: The published long.xyz mechanism docs show AGI sits in the narrow tier of tokens paired directly to $AI, where 0.5% of every trade routes into open-market $AI buys - meaning AGI is upstream fee plumbing for the ecosystem's de facto native token rather than just another launchpad meme. The market is reflexively buying the downstream beneficiary (AI, which has ~$3m of supply burned or locked and a vault that went $39k to $286k in under three weeks) while ignoring that the paired upstream tokens are what generate that flow and are re-rated by the same narrative. The 'superintelligence' terminology wave that the crowd is expressing through SI maps far more literally onto an AGI ticker, and that mapping has not been made yet. Asymmetry is the naming coincidence landing on top of an already-live fee mechanism.
